summary: A 邮箱群发 8 封；2025-09-18「Mini Industrial PoE Switch」群发引出 2 人同日真回：Michael Chao 问输入电源/温度/户外合规；Elizabeth Wang 问 -34~74℃ 户外机柜能否；Alan 09-19 答 -40~+75℃ + IP40 + 测温照片；Elizabeth 09-23 追问「3× 10/100/1000M + 802.3at PoE with Microfit Connector」有没有、公司介绍、认证、产地 → Alan 09-23 答「无现成型号，可开发，需评估数量/技术可行性」+ CE/FCC/RoHS/REACH/UKCA + 广东制造 → 无回；11-06、2026-03-30 两次推送无回。巨头规则（supermicro.com 在 GIANT_DOMAINS）自动 C。
type: 服务器/边缘计算巨头（疑为户外边缘机柜内嵌 PoE 板需求）

evidence.claim: 工程侧问输入电源/温度/户外合规
evidence.quote: May I know the input power and temperature specification? Any compliance for outdoor use?
Do you have something which can survive under -34 to 74 degrees which can survive inside outdoor cabinet?

notes: 巨头规则 → C 不动（Q-55 默认）；但需求是真的：3 口 GE 802.3at PoE + Microfit 连接器 = 板级/嵌入式 PoE 交换（装进他们的户外边缘机柜/设备），-34~74℃。Saga 的回答停在「可开发，需数量」——他们没给数量。美国巨头几乎必问 UL（Saga 无 UL，《背景信息》不做 UL）→ 天然断点。

draft_en.subject: Re: Mini Industrial PoE Switch — the 3×GE PoE / Microfit board, one year later
draft_en.body:
Hi Elizabeth,

Last September we stopped at "we can develop it, but we need the quantity". Picking that up properly:

- Nearest ready unit for reference: a 4 x GE 802.3at PoE + 1 x GE uplink industrial switch, -40 to +75 C, IP40 (tested photos were in my September mail). A 3 x GE board-level version with a Microfit connector is a custom build on the same platform.
- Certifications up front: CE/FCC/RoHS/REACH/UKCA. We do not hold UL. If UL is mandatory for that outdoor cabinet, please tell me and we both save time.

One question: is the requirement still live, and roughly what annual quantity are we talking about? That is the one number the engineering evaluation needs.

Thank you.
Alan
